status: Proposed design for review; not an implemented environment or a learned model
scope: One shared, finite-horizon, constrained MDP for all 1,200 synthetic profiles; profile-specific context and available actions

time.history_usage: 2025-2026 records are offline synthetic calibration/descriptive evidence, not information observed at January 2025. A historical backtest must respect its cutoff.
time.long_actions: Advance one month per step; retain education, job search, moving and contractual countdowns in state. Do not jump over months or let multi-month actions complete instantly.

data_supported: Initial cash, investment valuation, loan principal and APR snapshots
Initial employment status, age, city and household type
Reference net income and rent, monthly net cash movement
Goal labels, target dates, and mechanically generated target amounts

baseline_calibration.net_flow_mode: For a minimal replay use net_transactions as total net flow plus explicit intervention deltas; do not add reference salary again or subtract reference rent again.
baseline_calibration.decomposed_mode: For the monthly accounting engine require an explicit income and expense budget. Reference income minus historical mean net flow is only a residual proxy, not measured spending, because monthly income and transfers are unknown.
baseline_calibration.missing_fields: Choose disclosed defaults or request scenario inputs for essential/discretionary expense split, eligibility, pension income, withdrawal access, loan terms and programme costs. Do not silently infer these from age or job status.
baseline_calibration.date_consistency: Initialize cash, investments and debt from the same January 2025 snapshot. A later start needs an explicit roll-forward of every balance, not just replacing cash with December 2026 cash.

not_identified_by_data: Action-conditioned transition probabilities or causal action effects
Actual monthly gross income and detailed expenses
Job offers, negotiation success, education eligibility or salary premium
Investment composition, liquidity restrictions, returns and taxes
Pension balances, entitlements, retirement income or contribution rules
Loan eligibility, credit limits, amortization terms and refinancing fees
Household transitions, foreign currency balances, property or business valuations
Individual utility, acceptable risk, minimum living costs and time costs

dynamic: cash_chf, investment_value_chf, restricted_cash_chf and any other acquired asset values
loan list: principal, rate, minimum payment, remaining term and rate type
employment status, accepted job terms, work fraction, reference net income
education qualification and remaining study months
current rent, essential expenses, discretionary budget and committed recurring costs
retirement status and assumed pension/benefit income
active commitments and pending outcomes with countdowns, fees and cancellation conditions
current shock regime and remaining duration if shock dynamics have memory
goal allocations, consumed goal flags, one-time milestone flags
fixed_episode_context: initial age (derive current age from month)
user-confirmed goals and deadlines, including reserve versus spending-goal semantics
explicit scenario parameters and their synthetic/user/assumed provenance
eligibility and access assumptions not present in source files
derived_not_independent: net worth, monthly surplus, runway, goal distance and time remaining
Compute these from state; do not maintain inconsistent duplicate balances
state.markov_condition: Conditional on state, fixed context and action, the simulator must not need unrecorded history to generate the next state. If a parameter is updated from history, retain its sufficient statistics or belief state.

action_representation.description: A sparse structured monthly action: at most one major life decision plus compatible budget, allocation and financing controls. Mandatory expenses and scheduled debt service happen automatically.
action_representation.avoid: A Cartesian product of every catalogue scenario and every amount; choosing salary increases, promotions, scholarships or market returns as guaranteed outcomes
action_representation.candidate_generation: For the hackathon enumerate a few feasible amounts and offers from state, retain continuous accounting, and prune incompatible candidates. Discretization is for search, not rounding the ledger.
action_representation.goal_changes: Only the user changes objectives; the policy may not lower target amounts or extend deadlines to claim success.

action_families.action: Keep current commitments and advance a month
action_families.guards: Always retain a continuation/failure transition even when no elective action is feasible
action_families.effects: Apply income, expenses, scheduled payments, pending events and shocks

action_families.guards: User-specified essential floor and reducible budget; do not claim these are observed transaction categories
action_families.effects: Persist budget change and capture preference cost; do not repeatedly subtract the same saving
action_families.evidence: 209 profiles have negative average monthly net cash movement; a hypothetical CHF 500 monthly uplift prevents 14 recorded shortfalls

action_families.action: Search for work, accept an available offer, negotiate, or change work fraction
action_families.guards: Availability, qualifications, work/study capacity and current commitments; handle self-employment with explicit assumed income/cost regimes
action_families.effects: Search/negotiation has a cost and a delayed or uncertain result; accepted offers change future income under stated terms
action_families.evidence: All 39 student and 37 unemployed profiles have negative mean net cash movement; no offers or success probabilities are observed

action_families.priority: P0 for same-currency housing offers; P2 for international modelling
action_families.guards: Affordability including upfront costs, lease timing, household suitability and compatible employment
action_families.effects: Change recurring housing costs after move; refundable deposits become restricted assets, not consumption
action_families.evidence: 457 profiles have reference rent above 40% of reference net income; threshold is descriptive, not a legal affordability rule

action_families.action: Transfer money between cash and investments; allocate cash to reserve or spending goals
action_families.guards: Available uncommitted cash or sellable assets, explicit withdrawal fees/restrictions, no simultaneous redundant buy/sell
action_families.effects: Equal and opposite balance changes before costs; no immediate net-worth reward. Goal earmarking does not create money.
action_families.evidence: 1,199 investment snapshots; 60/61 cash-shortfall profiles own investments, but only 19 have enough opening investments to cover their recorded maximum gap

action_families.priority: P0 for debt servicing and extra repayment; P1 for new borrowing/refinancing
action_families.action: Repay extra principal, accept an eligible loan, or refinance an existing loan
action_families.guards: Outstanding balance, financing eligibility, credit cap, fees, repayment affordability and compatible actions
action_families.effects: Scheduled payment automatic; principal and interest distinct. Borrowing increases cash and debt equally. Refinancing replaces old debt rather than duplicating or erasing it.
action_families.evidence: 283 loans with zero scheduled payments in source; adding an assumed 60-month schedule produces 4 additional recorded-path shortfalls

action_families.action: Enroll in full-time/part-time education or training
action_families.guards: Eligibility, no duplicate enrollment, capacity constraints and funding plan
action_families.effects: Store study countdown, fees and income effects; graduation is a transition, and subsequent job/salary outcome is an assumption
action_families.evidence: 39 student profiles; only the master's scenario has numerical assumptions, for 120 profiles; source eligibility is unknown

action_families.priority: P1; withdrawals reuse P0 transfer action
action_families.action: Choose retirement timing or an explicit retirement-income arrangement
action_families.guards: User-defined eligibility and income assumptions; cannot claim Swiss pension calculation from supplied data
action_families.effects: Change employment and recurring income; drawdown uses the same investment/cash accounting as other profiles
action_families.evidence: 216 retired profiles; 81 have negative mean monthly cash movement, despite only 4 recorded shortfalls

action_families.action: Accept a user-specified purchase, family-cost change or business plan
action_families.guards: Committed funds, capacity and funding; templates require explicit data beyond this repo
action_families.effects: Schedule costs/income, account for acquired assets and state transitions; no unsupported property/pension/business valuation claims
action_families.evidence: 300 profiles have a second goal; 90 housing-deposit and 77 education-flexibility goals. Household and self-employment labels alone do not specify transition costs.

order: Validate action parameters and compatibility against state-dependent action mask
Apply agreed beginning-of-month decisions, loan drawdowns and upfront costs; test liquidity at this point
Realize explicitly modelled shocks and pending outcomes according to documented timing
Accrue investment returns and loan interest under stated conventions
Post income, consumption, tuition and mandatory debt service
Apply end-of-month discretionary transfers and extra debt principal payments within available balances
Update commitments, graduation/search timers, goal payments/flags and date
Reconcile cash, investment assets, debt and net worth; emit reward components and feasibility flags
transition_contract.cash_identity: closing_cash = opening_cash + income - consumption - one_off_consumption - tuition + borrowing - total_debt_payment - investment_purchase + investment_sale - other_asset_purchase + other_asset_sale - fees - deposit_transfer + deposit_release
transition_contract.other_asset_identity: closing_other_assets = opening_other_assets + valuation_change + acquired_asset_value - disposed_asset_carrying_value; sale proceeds and gains/losses reconcile explicitly
transition_contract.net_worth_identity: net_worth = cash + investments + restricted_cash + other_assets - debt
transition_contract.timing: Interest and returns depend on the exact event ordering; calculate them from the relevant balances, not an inconsistent monthly approximation
transition_contract.missing_funding: Record an explicit infeasible/funding-gap transition or a specified borrowing action. Never silently provide unlimited overdraft.
transition_contract.stochasticity: Start with deterministic transitions (a valid special case of an MDP). Add named stress paths first. Unemployment, promotion, tuition shocks, inflation and returns are environment outcomes with assumed laws, not freely selectable benefits.

objective.recommendation: Expose feasibility, goals and wealth separately; compare Pareto trade-offs rather than infer a universal best life decision
reward_components: goal achievement at each goal's deadline, paid only once
user-defined education/workload/lifestyle preference utility and action friction
terminal real net worth including outstanding debt and committed liabilities
objective.scalar_if_required: sum_t gamma^t * (preference_utility_t - action_disutility_t - lambda_gap*funding_gap_t - lambda_breach*violation_t + deadline_goal_reward_t) + gamma^T*lambda_wealth*terminal_real_net_worth
conditions: Normalize money by a documented fixed scale; weights and discount factor are explicit user/design assumptions
Cap goal rewards and track paid flags; avoid repeat rewards for withdrawing and re-depositing money
Do not reward borrowed cash or transfers as income
Enforce minimum consumption and commitments; otherwise zero spending or zero repayments wins artificially
Account for debt at the terminal date; avoid rewarding end-of-horizon borrowing
Reserve goals can overlap; spending goals must consume or earmark funds explicitly
Show education and retirement value/preferences; cash-only optimization otherwise favors working indefinitely

evaluation.before_rl: Implement simulator and compare continue, reserve-first/debt-aware rules, and a small model-based candidate search on identical scenarios
baselines: maintain chosen cash reserve then repay debt/invest surplus
tests: borrowing preserves net worth before fees
principal repayment preserves net worth before interest
evaluation.generalization: Split profiles by ID stratified by employment cohort; never randomly mix a person's months across train/test. Hold out assumption settings and shock paths as well. Historical fitting must respect the time cutoff. Report each cohort separately, since employed profiles dominate the sample and can hide failures for students or unemployed users.
evaluation.claim_limit: Even success on held-out synthetic profiles validates only the assumed simulator, not real-world optimal financial decisions.
